scope: Current source regression and a clean user-runtime distribution, including explicit resource closure, portable evidence availability, archive identity and isolated execution. Existing research/content task records retain their original limited scope.

publication_style.update_identity: Source inventory and SHA-256 content identity

platform_skips.reason: Must execute on real Windows; macOS success does not certify them.

checked_source_basis.scope: Sorted relative Python file names and raw SHA-256 bytes in core/, tools/ and tests/, excluding __pycache__

limits: Fictional jurisdictions and source packets only; no real law or real case validation.
The independent reviewer is an AI agent who also reviewed method/source guidance, not a human legal expert or the task executor.
Two cases cover the stated variants only in these supplied settings; they do not establish all-jurisdiction or all-subfield coverage.
Checks of byte identity do not alone establish execution chronology or legal correctness.
legal_tasks.scope: Old reviewed synthetic legal outputs remain bound to exact recovered guidance. Current software replay does not renew content review of changed shared guidance; legal-specific resources still match the recorded identities.

skill_creator_validation.scope: Discovery/frontmatter only; actual forward tasks are recorded separately.

preservation.scope: Frozen case inputs, numerical algorithms, authored outputs and independent reviews unchanged. Existing historical-guidance evidence also contains the exact original core/protocol.md source bound by the old legal review; no old runnable release or renewed scientific content review. Personal package excluded.

hosted_ci.binding: Read the run matching the selected exact commit. Generated dist/release-validation.json records actual archive and hosted-run acceptance separately to avoid self-referential commit/archive identities.

limits: Professional navigation examples do not establish complete coverage or new specialized task validation.
Recorded variant bindings are declarations, not a new execution or renewed scientific review; missing variants remain unspecified.
Existing synthetic tasks and AI-agent content reviews retain their original limited scopes.
Local full suite executed on macOS Python 3.14.6; match the actual commit-specific CI for other environments.
The discovery checker validates a documented safe YAML subset, not every optional host YAML structure.
Directory upgrade retains its documented short reader gap and caught-failure rollback; no power-loss transaction guarantee.

cross_material_review.scope: Independently executed synthetic text tasks and file-change verification; not semantic automation or full scientific review.

review_modes.scope: Two fresh same-model review contexts plus one actual response/delivery exercise; wholly synthetic author-owned inputs only. Not real journal peer review, efficacy measurement or acceptance prediction.

user_distribution.scope: Software distribution and declared file identity; no renewed disciplinary content review or certification.

platform_implementation.windows_backend: Native no-follow handles, directory guards, file identity and nonblocking LockFileEx writer locks; ordinary local directories.
platform_implementation.runtime_dependencies: Python 3.11+ standard library; no symlink privileges required for skill installation.
platform_implementation.verification: Actual OS execution is reported by commit-specific hosted jobs and the separate local receipt.
platform_implementation.frozen_replay_boundary: Windows test-only launcher explicitly reports POSIX CPU/alarm limits unavailable and RSS unmeasured-null; actual outer wall timeout and numerical comparisons remain. Frozen scientific source bytes are not rewritten.
platform_implementation.hosted_macos: macos-15-intel; distinct from local Apple Silicon validation. Previous arm64 pool capacity cancellations are not successful execution.
